critical_code_review_comments: playbooks_sprint3.py L57-64 — In handle_pattern_scan hotspot scan, per-dispute lookup of request+specialist uses ObjectId(d['request_id']) in a per-doc loop. On growing datasets this is N+1. Consider aggregation with $lookup on requests + $group by specialist_id in a single pipeline. Acceptable at current scale.

playbooks_sprint3.py L121-132 — Finance Reconciler orphan check iterates ≤500 transactions with 1-2 count_documents calls per tx (up to 1000 DB round-trips). Also acceptable at current volume (12 orphans found) but same $lookup aggregation pattern would be O(1) round trips. Add index on requests.id if not present.

playbooks_sprint3.py L65 — `hotspots = {sid: n for sid, n in per_spec.items() if n == 2}` uses exact equality (== 2). If a specialist has 3+ open disputes/30d they're already Medic-suspended and correctly excluded, but comment/business rule should be documented inline; a future dev reading `== 2` might change it to `>= 2` and duplicate Medic's job.

playbooks_sprint3.py L163-221 — handle_roadmap_advise has no per-day de-dup guard. If the cron fires twice (accidental restart or manual + cron on Friday), it produces 2 roadmap_advice docs + 2 admin notifications same day. Consider inserting only if last doc.ts < today start.

routes/orchestrator.py L119 — 400 error message is a long human-readable string. Consider returning structured `{detail: {message, valid_kinds: [...]}}` so clients can render dropdowns/hints without parsing the string.

routes/orchestrator.py L83-122 — simulate_signal is 40 lines of if/elif kind mapping. Extract a `SIMULATE_PAYLOADS: dict[str, callable]` module-level dict — same pattern as PLAYBOOKS — and remove the elif chain. Reduces cyclomatic complexity and makes adding kind 11 a one-line change.

playbooks_sprint3.py L20-22 — `_days_ago(n)` returns ISO string; queries use it against `created_at` field. Consistent with rest of codebase but requires all writers use isoformat() (previously flagged in iter94 for control_tower.py). Consider a shared helper module or type contract.
Positive: All 3 handlers respect payload['test'] correctly — no DB writes to pattern_findings, no Claude calls, no admin notifications in test mode. Clean separation.

Positive: Playbook toggle short-circuit works correctly at the engine level (handled=False, reason='playbook_disabled') — no wasted DB queries when a playbook is off. This is the correct behavior even though the API response shape differs from enabled runs.

Positive: Finance Reconciler escalation is real, not simulated — 12 legit orphan transactions surfaced, which is the whole point of the reconciler. Escalation gating (issues → escalate=True) is clean.
